name: Citadel Outlets
description: Citadel Outlets is Los Angeles' premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brands and restaurants housed in a distinctive Assyrian palace-inspired architectural setting. Located just minutes from downtown LA, LAX, and major Southern California attractions, the center offers shoppers significant savings on premium brands including Coach, Michael Kors, Nike, lululemon, The North Face, and many more. With its convenient location and extensive mix of fashion, athletic, and lifestyle retailers, Citadel Outlets serves as a major shopping hub for both local residents and international tourists visiting the LA area.
demographics: Citadel Outlets attracts a diverse, value-conscious shopper base including families, tourists, and bargain hunters seeking premium brands at outlet prices. The trade area draws heavily from Los Angeles County's working and middle-class households, with significant representation from Hispanic and Asian communities reflecting the surrounding Commerce and East LA demographics. Visitors include international tourists staying in downtown LA and LAX-area hotels, as well as Southern California residents seeking 25-65% off retail prices on designer brands. The center appeals to a wide age range from millennials to baby boomers, with household incomes typically ranging from $40,000 to $100,000 annually.
summary: Los Angeles' leading outlet shopping center featuring over 130 global brands in a unique Assyrian palace setting, conveniently located near downtown LA and LAX.
